content.summary: Focused assumption accounting confirms that I(27) is legitimately applied to the actual H2 subfamily, with inherited uniformity and sunflower-freeness and a proved intersection property. The revised Section 6 now accurately preserves external enumeration in Corollary 4 while excluding only the exploratory diagnostics from local proof premises. No new methodological or attribution issue requires revision.

checks.scope: Legitimacy of the sole external-sized input in the Profile A count window
checks.method: Inspected ProfileACounts.rows_two_card_le_twenty_seven and final_count_window, and checked how the filtered family inherits the hypotheses of I(27).
checks.observation: The Lean application supplies four-uniformity from uniform_H, sunflower-freeness by subfamily monotonicity, and rows_two_intersecting proved from the disjoint outsider bound. Thus I(27) bounds a genuine intersecting four-uniform subfamily rather than a numerical row count. The subsequent nonempty H2 choice is justified from the count equations, so the nine-completion lower bound does not assume its own witness.

checks.scope: Section 6 repair and computational assurance accounting
checks.method: Compared frozen rounds 3 and 4 at the changed paragraph and tested the replacement against Theorems 1–3, Corollary 4 and the retained failed diagnostic descriptions.
checks.observation: The replacement expressly retains I(27) where stated and expressly says Corollary 4 uses the external enumerative theorem. Only the subsequent cap45/SAT exploratory computations are excluded from local proof premises. The former overbroad avoidance-of-enumeration sentence is removed; no failed attempt or unchecked normalization is promoted to evidence of a theorem. This substantively addresses the committed writer objection, whose originating reviewer can record closure.
